card.name: Small largest denominator in an Egyptian expansion of 5/31

task.name: Small largest denominator in an Egyptian expansion of 5/31
task.description: Return 1..256 distinct denominators in [1,10000000] summing reciprocally to exactly 5/31. Minimize the LARGEST denominator, not the term count. One fixed rational instance of the denominator-size problem; the paper provides asymptotic bounds, not this local benchmark optimum.
task.contract: construct() -> candidate. Return 1..256 distinct denominators in [1,10000000] summing reciprocally to exactly 5/31. Minimize the LARGEST denominator, not the term count.
